title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Returned Payout Re-Send Desk Reference
content:
## Returned payouts on Cartwise Shopper Payouts

When a weekly deposit or an instant cashout is sent back by the receiving bank or card, the returned amount is credited back to the shopper's unpaid earnings balance and a returned-transfer entry is booked on the payout account.

**Rule.** Once a new destination is on file after a transfer came back and the account is active again, the returned amount is sent again at once as its own re-send deposit, which points to the returned-transfer entry it answers, instead of waiting for the next weekly sweep.

Put differently, the re-send is a deposit of its own: it is not folded into a weekly sweep, and each re-send deposit records which returned-transfer entry it answers. The amount of the re-send is a figure the agent works out from the Cartwise Shopper Payouts rules and the account's records before the booking; the booking itself does not work it out.

| Business situation | Result governed | Observable effect on the account |
|---|---|---|
| A transfer came back, a new destination is on file and the payout account is active again | The amount of the re-send deposit | A re-send deposit entry pointing to the returned-transfer entry; the unpaid earnings balance falls by the amount re-sent |

## Tool: `resend_returned_transfer_f902fe69`

**Capability.** Books one re-send deposit on a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account: the stated amount leaves the unpaid earnings balance and goes to the payout destination currently on file, and the deposit points to the returned-payout entry it answers, so the shopper can see which bounced payout is being sent again. The unpaid earnings balance shown on the account falls by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** The tool is agent-side. The agent unlocks `resend_returned_transfer_f902fe69` and then calls it; the shopper does not run it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_account_id` | The shopper payout account number the re-send is booked on, as read from the payout account lookup | Identifier |
| `returned_event_id` | The reference number of the returned-payout entry (the entry recording that a deposit or cashout came back) this re-send answers, as read from the payout account's entries lookup | Identifier |
| `resend_usd` | The amount sent again, in US dollars | A positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), booked exactly as given with no further rounding |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `status` "resent"; `payout_event_id`, the reference number of the new re-send deposit entry; `returned_event_id`, the returned-payout entry it answers; `amount_usd`, the amount sent with 2 decimal places; `event_date`, the booking date as YYYY-MM-DD; and `available_balance_usd`, the unpaid earnings balance left on the account with 2 decimal places.

*Hypothetical receipt reading:* a receipt showing `amount_usd` 62.40 and `available_balance_usd` 15.10 means a re-send deposit of 62.40 was booked and 15.10 of unpaid earnings remains on the Cartwise Shopper Payouts account.
